roi_crop_spec.description: ROTATION-ALIGNED palm ROI crop. MUST be implemented identically in the app — this is the v5 change that fixes angle-dependent false rejects. Any mismatch reintroduces the train/deploy bug.
steps: 1. Detect 21 hand landmarks on the ORIGINAL, unrotated frame.
2. Vector from landmark[0] (wrist) to landmark[9] (middle MCP), pixel coords.
3. current_angle_deg = atan2(y9 - y0, x9 - x0), in degrees.
5. Rotate the WHOLE frame by (-rotation_needed_deg) about the image center: getRotationMatrix2D(center, -rotation_needed_deg, 1.0) + warpAffine, same canvas size, BORDER_REPLICATE, INTER_LINEAR.
6. Transform all 21 landmarks through the SAME rotation matrix.
7. From ROTATED landmarks: palm_center = mean of indices [0,1,2,5,9,13,17]; span = distance(landmark[9], landmark[0]); half_size = 1.1 * span.
8. Square crop of the ROTATED image at [center +/- half_size] on both axes.
10. If NO hand detected: center-square crop of the raw frame, NO rotation.

notes: v5 ROTATION-ALIGNED CROP. The app MUST reproduce roi_crop_spec exactly: rotate the frame so wrist(0) -> middle_mcp(9) points straight up, THEN take the 1.1 x span square around the palm centre. See MediaPipeHandDetector.palmRoiFrom + PalmPreprocessor._cropPalmRoi. Skipping the rotation reintroduces the angle-dependent false rejects v5 exists to fix.

MEASURED NUISANCE FACTORS (v5 diagnostic, 3,210 real comparisons): in-plane rotation drove score decay at r=-0.322, p<0.0001 — this is what the rotation-aligned crop CANCELS. Out-of-plane tilt is r=-0.169, roughly half the effect, and is NOT corrected by anything: the crop cannot undo foreshortening. Observed in the field: same palm, same lighting, phone angled up vs down scored 0.607 where same-angle scored 0.800 (2026-08-16). Expect that.

THRESHOLD 0.5508 is FAR-0.1% derived on 98 held-out identities (AUC 0.9915, EER 4.27%). It SUPERSEDES the v4 interim 0.70, which was fitted to only 2 people. Do not carry 0.70 forward — it belongs to a different embedding space.
The SERVER decides. Firestore config/model overrides this file, so the live threshold is whatever that doc says — check there first when the numbers look wrong.
v5 changes the embedding space: EVERY template enrolled under v4 or earlier is invalid and must be re-enrolled. submitAttendance rejects cross-version comparisons rather than scoring them.
CLAHE is train-time augmentation only; do NOT apply at inference.
Enroll = mean of 4-8 L2-normalized embeddings, then re-normalize. NEVER compare single-shot embeddings.
Store hand_side explicitly; gate left/right before comparing.
INT8 is not viable for this backbone (int8_viable=false). Use fp32 on mobile.
